verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox documents on-request open-and-scan of letter contents delivered as PDFs, going beyond envelope images ("Open and Scan Mail (PDFs)", operator opens and scans contents on request). Nothing states a scan turnaround or that the PDFs are searchable, and scanning is on-request rather than automatic. Missing for 10: stated same/next-business-day turnaround, searchable/OCR PDFs, independent or hands-on corroboration of scan quality and speed.
